title: Akmagnus
extract:
The Akmagnus is the dual version of the  Magnus, which features enhanced firepower at the expense of accuracy and reload speed. 
It can be sold for ‍ 5,000. 

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Impact damage.
Advantages over other Secondary   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
Above average crit chance (22.00%)
High burst DPS (597.8)
Above average sustained DPS (298.9)
Above average damage per shot (119.56)
Above average total damage (98)
Very high ammo pickup (40)
High ammo max (210)
Above average fire rate (5.00 attacks/sec)
Above average status chance (22.00%)
High disposition (●●●●● (1.35x))
Above average crit multiplier (2.00x)
Disadvantages over other Secondary   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
Low accuracy (2.00° to 16.00°)
Very low reload speed (3.20 s)
See WARFRAME Wiki:Stat Comparison/Percentiles for more details.

Comparisons:

 Akmagnus (Normal Attack), compared to  Magnus (Normal Attack):
Equal base damage
Higher burst DPS (597.8 vs. 517.69)
Higher sustained DPS (298.9 vs. 262.22)
Higher fire rate (5.00 attacks/sec vs. 4.33 attacks/sec)
Larger magazine (16 vs. 8)
Slower reload time (3.20 s vs. 1.80 s)
Less accurate (11.1 vs. 16)
Wider first-shot spread (2.00° vs. 0.50°)
Wider maximum spread (16.00° vs. 12.00°)
Higher Mastery Rank required (12 vs. 10)
Lower disposition (●●●●● (1.35x) vs. ●●●●● (1.53x))
Comparisons:

 Akmagnus (Normal Attack), compared to  Akmagnus Prime (Normal Attack):
Equal base damage
Lower base critical chance (22.00% vs. 28.00%)
Lower base critical multiplier (2.00x vs. 2.80x)
Lower base status chance (22.00% vs. 28.00%)
Lower average damage per tap (119.56 vs. 147.39)
Lower burst DPS (597.8 vs. 835.71)
Lower sustained DPS (298.9 vs. 419.48)
Lower fire rate (5.00 attacks/sec vs. 5.67 attacks/sec)
Slower reload time (3.20 s vs. 2.80 s)
Lower Mastery Rank required (12 vs. 15)
Higher disposition (●●●●● (1.35x) vs. ●●●○○ (1.10x))

Acquisition
The Akmagnus's blueprint can be purchased from the Market.

Tips
To shorten the reload time of 2.4 seconds, equipping  Quickdraw/ Primed Quickdraw may be preferred, or  Stunning Speed to benefit both the reload time and status chance.
The Akmagnus can achieve a high rate of fire by binding the fire command to the mousewheel. As the Akmagnus retains a manageable level of recoil even during rapid fire, this can be used to enhance the Akmagnus's firepower even up to medium range engagements.
With its good status chance, critical chance, and damage, the Akmagnus can easily be built for crit focused, status focused or hybrid builds.
